BIOLOGY — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #19
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: BIOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

----

   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Overgrazing continuously

4. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Only carbon dioxide

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Response and Coor? (1 mark)

   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Genetics.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Genetics.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Genetics.

9. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

10. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. A mixture of two liquids

11. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

12. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 37 °C

13. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Milk souring

14. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

15. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. watt (W)
   D. joule (J)

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Response and Coordination in Plants? (1 mark)

   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Evolution.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Evolution.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Evolution.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Evolution.

20. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Producers
